LESSON: CLOTHING CONSTRUCTION PROCESSES ● STITCHES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE
Strand: Clothing and Textiles
Topic 3.3: Clothing Construction Processes ● Stitches
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Clothing Construction Processes ● Stitches, part of Clothing and Textiles in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: How do different stitches affect the quality and durability of a garment? 2. How can stitches be creatively used in clothing construction?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. classify stitches used in clothing construction,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Clothing Construction Processes ● Stitches in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. make stitches used in clothing construction,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Clothing Construction Processes ● Stitches in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the use of stitches in clothing construction.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Clothing Construction Processes ● Stitches in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. classify stitches used in clothing construction,

B. make stitches used in clothing construction,

C. appreciate the use of stitches in clothing construction.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: As the learner clearly describes the procedure followed when working the stitches and giving focused

feedback during class presentations.

● Communication and collaboration: As learners participate actively in working out stitches and peers assess each

other’s work.

● Digital literacy: As learners’ access information from digital learning platforms on procedures of working out different

stitches.

Values:
● Unity: As learners appreciate the efforts of others when making different stitches.

● Respect: Learners appreciate diverse opinions during discussions on different types of stitches.
